_about: Example Config values for a small business (e.g. a local shop, cafe, salon or restaurant). Copy the keys below into the Config node, replacing the existing ones. Keys starting with _ are ignored.
instructions: Classify this email received in the shared Gmail inbox of a small local business into exactly one category. Decide by what the email is about and why it was sent, not only by who sent it.

categories.name: Customers
categories.criteria: Messages written by customers or guests: questions, complaints, compliments, special requests, catering or group enquiries, contact-form submissions

categories.name: Orders & Bookings
categories.criteria: Orders, reservations and appointments made by customers through the website, booking tools or delivery platforms, including changes and cancellations

categories.name: Reviews
categories.criteria: New reviews and ratings about the business (e.g. Google Business Profile, Tripadvisor, delivery-platform ratings) and replies to them. Performance reports are NOT here.

categories.name: Suppliers
categories.criteria: Suppliers and wholesalers: quotes, order confirmations, delivery notes, supplier invoices, price lists and stock notices

categories.name: Bills
categories.criteria: Utility, telecom and rent bills for the premises only: electricity, water, gas, internet, phone, rent. Supplier invoices are NOT here.

categories.name: Banking & Payouts
categories.criteria: Bank statements, card-terminal and payment-processor reports, payouts from delivery or booking platforms, transfers and chargebacks

categories.name: Staff
categories.criteria: Employees and candidates: job applications, shift or holiday requests, payroll and HR-provider messages

categories.name: Tax & Official
categories.criteria: Accountant, tax office, licences and permits, health and safety inspections, insurance and other official paperwork

categories.name: Platforms & Accounts
categories.criteria: Transactional messages about the business's own software accounts (POS, website, booking and delivery platforms): receipts, renewals, policy changes, performance reports, sign-in alerts and verification codes

categories.name: Marketing & Promotions
categories.criteria: Bulk mail sent to many people: newsletters, offers and discounts, product announcements, advertising and SEO sales pitches, trade-fair and event marketing

categories.name: Other
categories.criteria: Emails that do not clearly fit any other category
